findings.title: Ollama 0.30.6 is older than 0.34.0
lines: AgentHandover's models need Ollama 0.34.0 or later; http://localhost:11434 answers with 0.30.6.
Only the Gemma 4 models require it: the configured models (qwen3.5:4b) are not Gemma 4, so this is a warning. Update before choosing a Gemma 4 tier.
Fix: update Ollama.app (menu bar icon > Restart to update), or download the current version from https://ollama.com/download

findings.title: Memory for the Standard tier: needs 4.7 GB, 9.0 GB available now
